checkpoints.description: [1/4] Planning and initial project skeleton: ADR-001, pyproject.toml, and seed

impact_assessment.why: Bootstrap CyberPulse retro-cyberpunk hacking game with deterministic mechanics
impact_assessment.benefits: Provides immersive terminal hacking gameplay with reproducible puzzle state and zero dependencies
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI and game state schema stability; dependency: none (standard library); concurrency: none; state: savegame power-loss atomicity
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use strict dataclasses, deterministic random seeds, atomic file writes, and thorough unit tests

[4/4] Interactive ANSI CLI, savegame management, integration tests, and README documentation
[1/5] Behavioral research synthesis, ADR-002, and data schemas for career meta-progression, contracts, and variable rewards

impact_assessment.why: Incorporate behavioral psychology and gaming addiction/engagement literature (SDT, variable ratio schedules, loss aversion, near-miss effect, compulsion loops) into CyberPulse
impact_assessment.benefits: Dramatically improves player engagement, retention, tactical depth, and dopamine feedback loops through risk-reward push-your-luck mechanics and meta-progression
impact_assessment.risks: contract: game state schema extensions; dependency: none (standard library); concurrency: none; state: savegame and career profile backward compatibility and crash atomicity
impact_assessment.mitigation: Support default values for schema expansion, use atomic tempfile persistence, and implement comprehensive unit tests
